warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the 2x2v Vlasov-Maxwell kernels at P2 together with the 2x2v LBO collision kernels. In `rt_vlasov_weibel_lbo_2x2v_p2.c`, `alpha` (line 102) is the amplitude of the seed perturbation; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong 2x2v P2 flux, a wrong 2x2v LBO diffusion or a wrong Maxwell coupling changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 4.5e-5 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 1.1e-3 (worst files `elc-imom.gkyl` and `elc-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 952x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
